item.title: Massachusetts Governor Healey announces certain residents will no longer be subject to state or federal income taxes
item.description: BOSTON – Today, Governor Maura Healey announced that thousands of Personal Care Attendants will no longer be subject to state or federal income taxes, which is projected to save them $5,000 or more per year.
